text:
Jordi: starting thread for the Pilot Slate planning — aim: short, high-signal beta for inference optimizations. Need agreements on recruitment, observability, and minimal launch criteria.
Maya: Proposing cohort size = 10 orgs, 10 weeks. Rationale: faster feedback loop and easier follow-ups. Split: 7 hosted, 3 private/VPC.
Hiro: Ops note: private installs require inbound peering + KMS alignment. Add 5-7 days for network + compliance checks.
Priya: From product: narrow the API surface. Minimum: chat completions + embeddings + token-level cost telemetry. Defer function calling and streaming until after week 4.
Jordi: Success metrics sketch: weekly DAUs from pilot users >= 50% of invited power users; latency target p95 < 300ms for single-turn; error rate < 1% over baseline; qualitative satisfaction >= 8/10 on monthly interview.
Maya: Add adoption signal: at least 4 distinct customers integrate model into a core product flow (search, support-response, summarization).
Hiro: Instrumentation ask: tag pilot traffic with pilot_id and org_hash, expose a /pilot-metrics endpoint. Quick sample: 
```
headers = {"x-pilot-id":"slate-1", "x-org":"acme"}
resp = client.generate(prompt, headers=headers)
```
Priya: Feedback cadence: short weekly pulse (3 Qs) via in-app banner + one 45m interview monthly. Also collect 5 golden prompts per org for regression checks.
Tariq: Sales/CS: recommend recruiting a mix of existing paying customers (5) + 5 new prospects. Offer a $3k bill-credit or equivalent gift for full program participation and timely feedback.
BenchBot: ci-bench: Please ensure we run nightly synthetic load at cohort config. Schedule INFRA-SLATE-002 for Dedicated reservations.
Maya: Launch gates before onboarding an org: 1) tagging and metrics pipeline validated end-to-end, 2) infra capacity ticket resolved, 3) onboarding security checklist accepted by customer, 4) internal runbooks + rollback steps documented.
Jordi: Risk register items: KV cache cold starts for long contexts, model fallback behavior under load, and billing reconciliation for credits. Add monitoring alert for cache-miss > 25% and regen errors spiking.
Hiro: Tech plan: implement ephemeral pilot keys with limited scope, ensure telemetry sanitization, and add a feature flag to toggle advanced sampling.
Priya: If a pilot org fails to meet engagement within 4 weeks, pivot to a guided workshop with product engineer and offer extended trial instead of immediate offboarding.
Maya: Action items: - Jordi: draft outreach email + invite script by EOD Tue - Maya: shortlist 15 candidates (will pick 10) by Wed - Hiro: prototype tagging headers + /pilot-metrics by Wed - Tariq: finalize incentive plan and sign-off by Thu - BenchBot: schedule INFRA-SLATE-002 and nightly synthetic runs
Jordi: I'll create a shared timeline doc and add the gating checklist. Flag any hard blockers here.
Hiro: Running a quick perf sweep this afternoon against a 5k-token workload, will report findings.
Priya: No objections. Keeping scope tight should help us iterate fast.
BenchBot: reminder: Pilot Slate kickoff meeting scheduled next Monday 11:00am PT.
